headline: Fortinet (FTNT) Heads Into Q2 Earnings As AI Security Optimism Meets A Pricey Valuation
summary: Fortinet (FTNT) heads into its upcoming second quarter earnings report with attention on forecast growth in both services and products, along with recent FortiEndpoint AI features and a broader global distribution pact with TD SYNNEX. See our latest analysis for Fortinet. Fortinet’s share price momentum has been choppy in the very short term, with a 7 day share price return of 5.7% down, but the 90 day share price return of 80.7% and 3 year total shareholder return of 98.4% point to strong...
